datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Mozambique to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications and scenarios were compiled into monthly spatial datasets for 2021 to track food security projections and humanitarian needs.
